name: Spirit-Hardened Frame
description: Channels calcifying death Essence through his body, granting the resilience of leathery wind-dried tissue: per 2 motes spent, add one point of bashing soak and half that (round down) to lethal soak. May be reactivated to stack, but total bashing soak cannot exceed Stamina + Resistance (half that for lethal). Compatible with armor.

name: Snake Bites Its Tail
description: Amplifies her metabolism with Essence to resist poison: for the scene, nullifies any poison whose resistance difficulty is lower than her permanent Essence, and adds Essence in automatic successes to Stamina + Resistance rolls against stronger ones. May be activated before exposure. Also lets her safely drink Resistance extra alcoholic drinks.

name: Scarlet Venom Technique
description: Venom suffuses every fluid in her body (same statistics as arrow frog venom): living beings consuming or internalizing her tainted fluids (kissing or more intimate contact) must roll Stamina + Resistance or suffer the full poison. Cannot be turned off or suppressed — the corruption is irreversible.

name: Ivory Blossom Carapace

cost.raw: 1 mote per 1B/1L, plus one lethal health level

description: Forces hundreds of bony spines through her skin to blossom into armored plates: 1 point of bashing and lethal soak per mote spent, plus a mobility penalty equal to half the soak rating (round down). Cannot spend more motes than Stamina + Resistance. Characters wearing armor cannot use it. The health-level cost applies only the first time it is used in a scene.

name: Bone Arsenal Method
description: Extrudes spikes or grows weapons from the limbs (requires Brawl 2). Growing spines costs 8 motes, 1 Willpower, one lethal health level and adds 2B/2L soak (stacks) plus lets 'unarmed' attacks (clinches, tackles) do lethal, and anyone grappling/striking her barehanded soaks Strength in lethal. Growing a melee weapon costs one lethal health level + 1 mote per +1 in Speed/Accuracy/Defense/lethal damage (none above permanent Essence). Weapons retract into the skeleton and can't be dropped or taken unless severed.

name: Crimson Petal Armor

cost.raw: 1 mote per 1B/1L, 1 Willpower, one lethal health level

description: Blood gushes from every pore to shape a suit of liquid armor that flows with her motion yet hardens like fine steel. Follows Ivory Blossom Carapace's rules except the armor is virtually weightless with no mobility penalty. Cannot be used alongside Ivory Blossom Carapace. When it expires the armor flows back through her mouth.

name: Flowing Wound Defense
description: Momentarily liquefies her body and possessions so a blow passes harmlessly through and re-solidifies: takes no damage from a single attack (secondary effects apply normally). A perfect defense duplicating Adamant Skin Technique. Must be invoked after the opponent spends motes but before the attack roll.

name: Plague Knows Its Master
description: Consecration to the Malfeans grants disease resistance (buyable repeatedly like Ox-Body): subtract permanent Essence from the difficulty of all Stamina + Resistance and Stamina + Endurance rolls to resist infection and disease (cumulative with the -2 all Exalted share). If a modified difficulty drops below 1, the character automatically avoids or purges the illness.

name: Armor-Calling Kata
description: Speeds donning armor: he gestures and his anima flows out to enfold the armor in a liquid shroud, fastening it perfectly by turn's end. The armor must be readily at hand (no further than Essence yards away); he cannot grab it from elsewhere with this Charm.

name: Void-Banished Mail
description: Stores his armor Elsewhere and recalls it as needed. He must be wearing it (all straps fastened) to banish it; it vanishes in ghostly light and may be re-summoned onto his person at any time. Only one suit stored at a time, recallable only if he is unarmored to receive it. Cannot banish armor substantially larger than the Exalt (no warstriders).

name: Inauspicious Shadow Plate
description: Her anima hardens into a suit of obsidian-black plate mail — an expression of her soul — providing 10L/10B soak with only a -1 mobility penalty. For an extra 2 motes she grows a sweeping black cape that entangles incoming blows, acting as a shield (+1 difficulty to all attacks against her).
